stories.title: Guardrails or Gridlock? Washington's AI Showdown Explodes After 'Catastrophic Risk' Warnings
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Refuses to Let Doomsayers Kill American AI Dominance as China Races Ahead
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Shrugs Off Warnings From AI's Own Creators That the Technology Has Gone Rogue
stories.poll_question: Should Congress impose binding safety rules on AI companies now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Heavy-handed rules would hand AI leadership to China and kill jobs.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Even AI executives warn unchecked systems pose catastrophic public risk.

stories.title: Ballot Security or Voter Suppression? Supreme Court Green-Lights Trump Mail Voting Overhaul
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Backs Trump's Common-Sense Move to Secure Mail Ballots Before Midterms
stories.liberal_headline: Court's Emergency Order Opens Door to Election 'Chaos' Weeks Before Ballots Go Out
stories.poll_question: Should Trump's new mail-ballot restrictions take effect before November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Uniform mail rules restore confidence in an election system voters distrust.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Officials say they literally cannot comply; ballots are already mailed.

stories.title: Rigged Map or Rule of Law? Missouri's Congressional Lines in Chaos Two Months From Election Day
stories.conservative_headline: Activist Judges Strip Missouri Voters of the Map Their Elected Legislature Passed
stories.liberal_headline: Missouri GOP's Mid-Decade Power Grab Collapses as Courts Block Rigged Map
stories.poll_question: Should Missouri's new Republican-drawn map be used in November?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Elected lawmakers draw maps, not unelected judges seeking Democrat outcomes.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Mid-decade redraws to manufacture seats betray voters and state law.

stories.title: Inflation Crisis or Growing Pains? $4.31 Gas and Fed Rate Hike Collide Before Midterms
stories.conservative_headline: Fed's Rate Obsession Punishes Working Families as Trump Demands Relief at the Pump
stories.liberal_headline: Trump's War Economy Sends Gas to $4.31 as Inflation Blows Hole in His Rosy Narrative
stories.poll_question: Who is to blame for rising prices and gas costs right now?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Rate hikes and green energy limits are strangling American consumers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: His war, tariffs and chaos drove fuel and food prices up.

stories.title: Enforcement Win or Crackdown Casualty? ICE Offers Legal Insurance to Local Cops Making Arrests
stories.conservative_headline: ICE Shields Brave Local Officers From Left-Wing Lawfare Over Immigration Arrests
stories.liberal_headline: ICE Dangles Liability Insurance to Recruit Local Police Into Mass Deportation Machine
stories.poll_question: Should local police be deputized to make federal immigration arrests?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Local partnership multiplies enforcement and protects officers from activist lawsuits.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Turning cops into ICE agents destroys community trust and invites abuse.

stories.title: Restraint or Retreat? Trump Orders Ukraine to Stop Hitting Russian Fuel Targets
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Puts American Drivers First, Tells Kyiv to Stop Blowing Up Global Fuel Supply
stories.liberal_headline: Trump Shields Putin's War Machine, Orders Ukraine to Halt Strikes on Russian Refineries
stories.poll_question: Should the U.S. restrict Ukrainian strikes on Russian energy sites?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Attacks on refineries spike prices Americans pay at the pump.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Handcuffing Ukraine rewards Moscow for bombing trains and civilians.

stories.title: Pardon Access or Pay-to-Play? Hidden Cameras Catch Lobbyists Pitching Clemency Deals
stories.conservative_headline: Media Sting Targets Lobbyists While Ignoring Decades of Democrat Clemency Favors
stories.liberal_headline: Undercover Video Exposes Lobbyists Selling Access to Trump's Pardon Pipeline
stories.poll_question: Do pardon lobbying revelations warrant a federal investigation?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Freelance lobbyists don't speak for the president's constitutional pardon power.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Selling clemency access to the wealthy is corruption in plain sight.

stories.title: Judicial Overreach or Checks and Balances? Judge Rules FEMA Firings Were Illegal
stories.conservative_headline: Another Rogue Judge Blocks Trump's Authority to Run His Own Executive Branch
stories.liberal_headline: Court Finds Trump Illegally Gutted FEMA as Disaster Season Batters American Communities
stories.poll_question: Can the president fire federal disaster staff at will?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Voters elected Trump to shrink a bloated, unaccountable federal bureaucracy.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Gutting FEMA by fiat broke the law and endangers storm victims.

stories.title: Polluter Accountability or Climate Lawfare? Supreme Court Takes Up Boulder's Suit Against Big Oil
stories.conservative_headline: Supreme Court Poised to End Left-Wing Cities' Scheme to Sue Energy Firms Into Oblivion
stories.liberal_headline: High Court Weighs Whether Oil Giants Can Be Held Accountable for Deceiving the Public
stories.poll_question: Should cities be able to sue oil companies for climate damages?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Energy policy belongs to Congress, not activist local juries and lawyers.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Companies that misled the public should cover the damage they caused.

stories.title: Protecting Taxpayers or Weaponizing Welfare? New Rule Forces States to Report Immigration Status
stories.conservative_headline: Trump Closes Loophole Letting Blue States Hide Illegal Aliens Collecting Taxpayer Benefits
stories.liberal_headline: New Rule Turns Food and Cash Aid Programs Into Immigration Surveillance Tools
stories.poll_question: Should state welfare agencies report recipients' immigration status to the feds?
stories.poll_option1_desc: Taxpayer aid is for citizens and legal residents, period.
stories.poll_option2_desc: Scaring families from food aid punishes hungry American-born kids.
